title: Vinyl Now Beats CDs In Dollars And Albums
hook: The format CDs replaced came back and beat them twice.
closing: Vinyl did not defeat streaming; it became the physical format listeners value most.
question: What record would you buy?

segments.say: Vinyl earned $1.2 billion in 2022. Buyers spent more than twice as much on records as CDs.
Vinyl sold 41 million albums. Its revenue lead reflects more buyers, not only higher prices.
Streaming still takes 84% of music revenue. Vinyl won the physical comeback while staying a premium niche.
